description: Defines the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, a cache for storing compressed TLS certificates with LRU eviction, used within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing compressed certificates with LRU eviction policy.

classes.name: UncompressedCerts

classes.name: CachedCerts

methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size.
